command: (() => { const write=navigator.clipboard.writeText.bind(navigator.clipboard); window.__terraClipboardWrite=null; navigator.clipboard.writeText=async(text)=>{const observation={matchesRenderedConfig:text===document.querySelector("pre code").textContent,completed:false,terra:JSON.parse(text).provider.openai.models["gpt-6.1-terra"]};window.__terraClipboardWrite=observation;try {await write(text);observation.completed=true;} catch(error) {observation.error=error.name;throw error;}};for(let node=document.querySelector("pre code").parentElement;node;node=node.parentElement){if(node.scrollHeight>node.clientHeight+10)node.scrollTop=0;}return true;})()
